preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call excludeFromFees() or excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees() to exclude attacker-controlled addresses from transaction fees. This allows the attacker to bypass the 1% additional fee when selling to automated market maker pairs, effectively enabling privileged trading. Alternatively, use setExcludeFromAll() to both exclude from fees and dividends in one call.
